elements.requirement: Section 14 applies in relation to a trust of proceeds of sale of land and trustees of such a trust in the same manner as it applies in relation to a trust of land and trustees of land.
elements.quote: Section 14 applies in relation to a trust of proceeds of sale of land and trustees of such a trust as in relation to a trust of land and trustees of land.

elements.requirement: Subject to subsection (5), a trust of proceeds of sale of land means any trust of property (other than a trust of land) that consists of or includes proceeds of a disposition of land held in trust (including settled land) or any property representing such proceeds.
elements.quote: “trust of proceeds of sale of land” means (subject to subsection (5)) any trust of property (other than a trust of land) which consists of or includes— (a) any proceeds of a disposition of land held in trust (including settled land), or (b) any property representing any such proceeds.

elements.requirement: The references to a trust in subsection (3) apply to any description of trust (whether express, implied, resulting or constructive), including a trust for sale and a bare trust.
elements.quote: The references in subsection (3) to a trust— (a) are to any description of trust (whether express, implied, resulting or constructive), including a trust for sale and a bare trust

elements.requirement: The references to a trust in subsection (3) include any trust created, or arising, before the commencement of the Trusts of Land and Appointment of Trustees Act 1996.
elements.quote: include a trust created, or arising, before the commencement of this Act

elements.requirement: A trust that is a settlement for the purposes of the Settled Land Act 1925 (despite section 2) cannot be a trust of proceeds of sale of land.
elements.quote: A trust which (despite section 2) is a settlement for the purposes of the Settled Land Act 1925 cannot be a trust of proceeds of sale of land.

elements.requirement: In subsection (3), the term 'disposition' includes any disposition made, or coming into operation, before the commencement of the Trusts of Land and Appointment of Trustees Act 1996.
elements.quote: “disposition” includes any disposition made, or coming into operation, before the commencement of this Act

elements.requirement: In subsection (3), the reference to settled land includes personal chattels to which section 67(1) of the Settled Land Act 1925 (heirlooms) applies.
elements.quote: the reference to settled land includes personal chattels to which section 67(1) of the Settled Land Act 1925 (heirlooms) applies
